output_list.reason: The mint function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function allows the owner to mint a new token and transfer it to any user input address, causing a integer overflow in the totalSupply and tokenIndexToOwner mapping, and allowing the owner to arbitrarily increase the balance of any user.

The mintBatch function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function allows the owner to mint a batch of new tokens and transfer them to any user input addresses, causing a integer overflow in the totalSupply and tokenIndexToOwner mapping, and allowing the owner to arbitrarily increase the balance of any user.
